notes: Explicit bindings from careers-portal URL to source_spec JSON. Exact match only: DeclarativeSourceAdapter.supports() compares PortalTarget.normalized_jobs_url against these keys with plain string equality. No host similarity, no ATS-family inference, no substring or regex matching. normalized_jobs_url values are the spec-owned career_site URLs (operator-configured). Adding a source means appending one entry here; nothing else infers it.
